proposal.name_zh: 罗瑞卿：公安创建·军警分途·警卫思想
proposal.name_en: Luo Ruiqing: Public Security Founding · Separate Police and Military Tracks · Guarding Doctrine
historical_domains: 公安军与内卫边防体制
proposal.civilization_sphere: 现代中国/人民公安与内卫体系/军队政治工作 / Modern China / People’s Public Security and Internal Security / Military Political Work

proposal.unique_thinking_zh: 罗瑞卿（1906-1978），四川南充人，中国人民解放军的杰出领导人，新中国首任公安部部长（1949.10–1959.9），1955 年被授予大将军衔（开国十大大将之一）。主持公安工作期间，他确立「党委领导＋群众路线」的根本路线，形成「镇压与宽大相结合」的政策表述与「杀一批，关一批，管一批」的分类处置；在武装力量编成上主张军警分途，提出公安部队「既是公安，又是部队」、指挥关系属军委、工作关系属公安部；在纪律作风上以「不准坐霸王车、吃霸王饭、看霸王戏」立规并推动《公安人员八大纪律、十项注意》。他领导中央警卫工作，把「一要保证不出乱子，二要不脱离群众」的二元约束贯彻到部署细节；在军队政治工作中坚持政治与军事、政治与业务的辩证统一，反对「空头政治」；1978 年支持「实践是检验真理的唯一标准」的讨论，同年 8 月 3 日逝世，悼词与 1980 年平反通知为其官方评价坐标（相关条目均据 1949–1965 年文献与 1978/1980 年评价文件）。
proposal.unique_thinking_en: Luo Ruiqing (1906-1978), from Nanchong, Sichuan, was an outstanding leader of the Chinese People’s Liberation Army, the first Minister of Public Security of New China (Oct 1949 - Sep 1959), and one of the ten senior generals (1955). While leading public security work he established the fundamental line of Party committee leadership plus the mass line; he shaped the policy formulation of combining suppression with leniency and the classification of "execute a batch, imprison a batch, supervise a batch"; on the composition of armed forces he advocated separate tracks for police and military, holding that the public security forces are "both police and troops", with command belonging to the Military Commission and working relations to the Ministry of Public Security; on conduct he laid down the bans on "bully cars, bully meals and bully shows" and promoted the eight disciplines and ten attentions for public security personnel. He directed central guarding work and carried the dual constraint of "no disturbances and no divorce from the masses" into deployment detail; in military political work he upheld the dialectical unity of politics with military affairs and professional work, opposing "empty politics"; in 1978 he backed the debate on practice as the sole criterion of truth. He died on 3 August 1978; the eulogy and the 1980 rehabilitation notice form the coordinates of his official evaluation. (All entries are anchored to sources of 1949-1965 and the evaluative documents of 1978/1980.)

proposal.legacy_assessment: 罗瑞卿长期主持新中国公安工作与公安部队建设，参与中央警卫与国家内卫体系的组织实施，并在军队政治工作中坚持政治与军事、政治与业务的辩证统一；1978-08-12 悼词与 1980-05-20 平反通知为其官方评价坐标（评价与记录文本分层使用）。
proposal.scholarly_value: 公安工作路线、军警体制沿革与军队政治工作的标本性史料（1949—1965 年文献＋1978/1980 年评价文件）。
